NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE REPEAL OF THE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (REPEAL)
ORDINANCE, 2004
An Ordinance to
repeal the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Market (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette. of N.
-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 17th August, 2004]
No. LEGIS.I/4(94)/4914, dated
17-8-2004----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West,
Frontier Province Repeal of the Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 5th October,
2002.

Repeal of N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XXXVIII of 2002 and revival of Pb. Act V of 1939

ORDINANCE II OF 2004
ORDINANCE II OF
2004
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE REPEAL OF THE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (REPEAL)
ORDINANCE, 2004
An Ordinance to
repeal the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Market (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette. of N. -W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 17th August, 2004]
No. LEGIS.I/4(94)/4914, dated
17-8-2004----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Repeal of N.-W.F.P. Ord.
No. XXXVIII of 2002 and revival of Pb. Act V of 1939.-----(1) The North-West
Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002 (N.-W.F.P.
Ord. No. XXXVIII of 2002), is hereby repealed and shall be deemed to have been
so repealed with effect from the 5th October, 2002, as if it had
never come into force.
(2) Consequent upon the repeal of
the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal).
Ordinance, 2002 (N.-W.F.P. Ord : No. XXXVIII of 2002), under, subsection (1),
the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 (Pb. Act No: V of 1939), as
applicable in the North-West Frontier Province immediately before its repeal,
shall stand revived and, for all intents and purposes, be deemed to have been
so revived with effect from the 5th October, 2002, as if it had never been
repealed.
